title: StageDefinition centraliza a seleção de cenário sem esconder o budget
claim: A escolha de cenário deve ser uma definição de dados compartilhada por inicialização, seleção e runtime; a abstração reduz bifurcações, mas não prova câmera, DMA ou qualidade visual.

evidence.capture_result: stage2 selected through P1 C, clean PAL-240 round reached on the 512x256 asset; schema 7 decoded screen_height=240

limitations: The Stage 2 regression route recorded zero combat events; it is not a replacement for the directed 16 HIT/1 PROJECTILE session.
HPRB reports max DMA 8288 bytes versus the 7782-byte nominal NTSC budget; no promotion to budget_validated.
The Showdown source is a controlled study fixture from the training lab, not final authorial art; visible tile repetition remains pending visual review.
Camera movement, audio and visual quality still require directed review; schema 7 now proves screen_height=240 in the PAL route, while the NTSC route remains over its nominal DMA envelope.
